description: US airline passenger rights: denied boarding compensation calculator for an involuntary bump from an oversold flight under 14 CFR 250.5. Returns the tier (0%, 200% or 400%), the formula result and the cap applied, the right to cash instead of a voucher, the exceptions, and the regulation's definition of fare. It covers involuntary bumps only, not volunteers, who negotiate their own deal with the airline. Input: only the one-way fare, the route type and the optional alternate-flight delay in hours; names, confirmation codes, ticket numbers and frequent flyer numbers aren't needed or used.

alternate_arrival_delay_hours.description: How many hours after the original flight's planned arrival the alternate flight the airline offered is planned to arrive (at the destination or first stopover). Omitted when no alternate flight was offered.

one_way_fare_usd.description: One-way fare in US dollars to the passenger's destination or first stopover (a planned break of more than 4 hours), including all mandatory taxes and fees but not optional extras such as seat or bag fees. This is how 14 CFR 250.1 defines "fare". An award or other zero-fare ticket is 0.

route.description: domestic = within the US; international_from_us = an international flight departing a US airport.

name: calculate_bump_compensation
title: Calculate US denied boarding (bump) compensation
